name: code-cleaner
description: Codezal-native dead-code & cruft finder. Read-only: it reports unused code, imports, dependencies, and duplication with a confidence tier per finding and never edits or deletes. /clean is a fast, scoped scan of high-confidence cruft; /clean-deep is a repo-wide audit (dead code, circular deps, duplication, complexity) with a safest-first removal plan. Language-agnostic: it confirms every finding against the Code Map instead of guessing.
